opportunity_tier_basis: Written by run profile --campaign CAMP-20260830-01 on 2026-09-01. Newly profiled and COMPLETE; opportunity tier defaults to O2 because only run selection may promote a profile to O1.

placements.role: Supplies high-speed Ethernet switching fabrics for AI data-center networks.

role_evidence.claim: Dell'Oro's June 2026 release ranks Arista in AI back-end networking, while IDC identifies most Arista Ethernet revenue as data-center based.

business_summary: Arista Networks, Inc. supplies high-performance, high-margin Ethernet switching fabrics used heavily in cloud and AI data-center back-end networks, sold mostly through a small number of hyperscale customers. It sits on the networking-optics link only.

exposure_summary.narrative: Dell'Oro's June 2026 release ranks Arista in AI back-end networking, and IDC separately identifies most of Arista's Ethernet revenue as data-center based; together these are among the more direct dated claims in this batch, though neither discloses an AI-specific revenue percentage.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for this chain's links is disclosed in the sources on file: the mapping role_evidence for ARISTA-NETWORKS carries qualitative product/operator claims, not a segment revenue split, and no data/edgar/docs/ANET.json filing is on disk this run to check for one.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/ANET.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/ANET.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (9005700000 / 4381310000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/ANET.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 3856100000 divided by Revenues 9005700000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/ANET.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 4371900000 divided by net income 3511400000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: data/market/ANET.json fundamentals is missing or has stale/mismatched-period data for: total_debt (stale, last observation 2014-06-30); net debt to EBITDA cannot be computed without mixing periods or inventing a figure.

piotroski.basis: data/market/ANET.json quality.piotroski.state is PENDING_DATA: insufficient companyfacts inputs to score Piotroski for ANET.

beneish_state.basis: data/market/ANET.json quality.beneish.state is PENDING_DATA: insufficient companyfacts inputs to score Beneish for ANET.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 245494970000.0 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 1256500000 (as of 2025-12-31) multiplied by the close 195.38 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/ANET.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/ANET.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 245494970000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 9005700000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/ANET.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 245494970000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 GAAP net income 3511400000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/ANET.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 243204770000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 9005700000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 243204770000.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 4356149000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.3497, '7': 0.2576, '10': 0.1929}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

crowdedness_caveats: networking-optics is chain-heat CROWDED; Arista is a widely held, heavily sell-side-covered cloud-networking bellwether, not a hidden name.

Piotroski and Beneish are both NULL here (data/market/ANET.json quality reports PENDING_DATA), despite an otherwise complete-looking fundamentals series, so this profile cannot corroborate quality with those two scores.

catalysts.claim: Arista is ranked in AI back-end networking by Dell'Oro, and IDC separately attributes most of its Ethernet revenue to data centers, two independent dated sources pointing the same direction.
Operating margin of 42.8% and operating-cash-flow-to-net-income of 1.25x are the strongest combination of profitability and cash conversion in the networking-optics batch.
catalysts.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/ANET.json

risks.claim: data/market/ANET.json's only total_debt observation is dated 2014-06-30, twelve years stale; leverage is reported NULL here rather than asserting a current zero-debt balance sheet off a decade-old data point.
Price-to-sales of 27.3x and price-to-earnings of 69.9x already price in sustained hyperscale-networking growth; a small number of large customers concentrates the demand this multiple depends on.

disposition.basis: Newly profiled to close the networking-optics link's zero-coverage gap. Retained at O2: the strongest margin and cash-conversion profile in this batch, but already priced at a premium multiple and missing both quality scores, so it is not carried further than a complete medium profile this run.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
